subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should one-way A2A handoff be added as an explicit `sessions_send` mode, as a separate one-way tool, or deferred while narrower A2A duplicate-delivery bugs are fixed first?
rationale: Source inspection proves the requested behavior is missing, but choosing the model-facing API shape changes session semantics and compatibility for existing A2A workflows.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clearly named one-way mode, keep conversation behavior as the default, and document/test both modes.

options.title: Create separate delivery primitive
options.body: Add a `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool so one-way dispatch cannot be confused with conversational `sessions_send`.

options.title: Defer dispatch semantics
options.body: Keep current conversation semantics and handle narrower bugs such as reverse-call suppression through focused fixes only.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clearly named one-way mode, keep conversation behavior as the default, and document/test both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for session-tool semantics and A2A lifecycle decisions points to steipete-authored work across the core files and docs.
